learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to define the six main groups of manufacturing technology and assign the corresponding subgroups and individual processes.
characterize manufacturing processes and structure them according to different distinguishing features.
correctly apply the basic nomenclature for processes, quality criteria, materials, and tools.
describe the material-physical, manufacturing-technical, tool- and machine-specific fundamentals of the individual processes and therefore evaluate their suitability.
compare, evaluate, and select different processes for a given manufacturing task based on various criteria.

syllabus_topics: Classification of manufacturing processes and definition of terms
Technical quality characteristics and workpiece accuracy
